name: stage2 r5 reader cap resets for new blockers
anchor: At most 3 fresh-reader passes in total per spec version, including checks after confirmation changes.
replacement: Stop after 3 passes with no new blocking gap; reset for new blockers.

name: stage2 r5 oversized skeleton stays whole
anchor: A walking skeleton over the budget is too thick: thin it to the shortest complete path and move the rest to P2/P3.
replacement: If the walking skeleton alone is over the budget, keep it whole.

name: stage2 r5 personal default invents history
anchor: For a question about the user's own past or situation, use a neutral default stating what the product assumes when unknown; never invent a first-person answer or record an unknown history as fact.
replacement: A default may invent a first-person answer about the user's past.

name: stage2 r5 default accepts unexplained failure risk
anchor: A recommended default must not choose the option its own trade-off names as a product failure risk, unless the question says in one line why that risk is accepted.
replacement: Choose the failure-risk option without explaining why.

name: stage2 r5 asks provider instead of need
anchor: Never ask the user to pick a library, provider or service: ask the product need it serves and decide the pick as engineering, unless the user must hold an account, pay, or would notice the difference.
replacement: Never ask the user to pick a library; offer providers as alternatives.

name: stage2 r5 skips question constraint check
anchor: Before sending, check each question's text, default, trade-off and alternatives against the fixed constraints and build constraints; remove promises the build cannot keep and surface real conflicts under Request fidelity.
replacement: Check only the default against constraints.

name: stage2 r5 widening applies on silence
anchor: Keep the requested scope and the safeguard, and list the widening first in the confirmation as a `[delegated]` "default unconfirmed" assumption that applies only if the user explicitly asks for it.
replacement: List the widening in the confirmation as a default that applies unless the user objects.

name: stage2 r5 mockup edits skip visual check
anchor: After any edit to a mockup, re-render it at the width it was made for and re-render the comparison page; look at both screenshots and fix any overlap, clipping or broken wrapping before the confirmation round.
replacement: After a mockup edit, reuse the old screenshot.

name: stage2 r5 mockup confirmation stalls without a renderer
anchor: If rendering is unavailable, attach the revised HTML paths and say the revision wasn't visually checked;
replacement: If rendering is unavailable, keep confirmation pending until it is;

name: stage2 r5 records raw acknowledgement as decision
anchor: An entry states the decision itself, with who gave it and the question ID; never use a bare acknowledgement as decision text. A design direction pick is Taste, whoever gave it.
replacement: Record raw acknowledgements as decisions and classify design picks as Mechanical.

name: stage2 r5 an answer grants release
anchor: Hard stops still apply: no answer or default grants release, production, spending or an outside action;
replacement: Hard stops still apply: a default can't authorize spending; an explicit answer can grant release or production;

name: stage2 r5 reader role keeps the old stop rule
anchor: Identify repeated findings by their concrete failure, so the parent can tell repeats from new blockers.
replacement: Identify repeated findings by their concrete failure so the parent can stop after 3 passes with no new blocking gap.

name: stage2 r5 writes Claude Code memory
anchor: Never write Claude Code memory files (auto-memory included), with any tool; keep learnings in the project notes the skills name.
replacement: Write learnings to Claude Code memory.
